entities.summary: Oumoul Khairy Sarr is a Senegalese basketball professional player and a member of the Senegalese national team. She has spent most of her professional career in Spain but has also played in France, Mexico, Poland, Turkey and Iceland. In 2021, she won the Mexican national championship.
